driver: A person's hit rate on test items drawn again and again from a fixed set, with the answer shown after each, rises with every earlier showing of the same item, so the rate over all showings measures recognition for the people shown the set most often; only the showings of items new to that person measure how they do on an item never seen before, and an item counts as seen once any of its several versions has been shown.
driver_concrete: Each screening officer's threat image projection hit rate over the twelve months to 30 November 2026 rises with every earlier projection of the same threat object, because the CT library holds a fixed set of objects, each in several scans, and a full-time officer is shown hundreds of projections a year with feedback after each; the officers shown the library most often are carried over 80 per cent by recognition, and only first showings of an object new to the officer, counting any of its scans, measure detection of an item a passenger carries.
stump: A competent solver reads the standard's detection performance on items each officer had not been shown before, keys the item on the image number or counts showings only inside the screening year, and withdraws four casual officers; an orientation new to the officer of an object already shown is detected 99.3 per cent of the time and an object first shown before the year over 99 per cent, so six full-time officers who detect 56 to 74 per cent of new objects clear 80 per cent.

lineage.driver: Each unit's change across an event is tested for exceeding what the event alone would leave, but the units' levels swing between periods in local cycles shared within each place for reasons unrelated to the event, so a test built on a unit's within-period variation finds most units in the places whose cycles happened to rise across the event; only a null built from the units' changes between periods without the event, or from their same-place peers, holds the error rate and leaves the one group whose units truly moved.
lineage.why: The decisive step was the scale a one-dimensional per-unit statistic is read against, and that is arithmetic: the golden's 28 found stations are exactly the top 28 of 369 by the change in margin over the two windows, with a 1.2233 cent a litre gap to the 29th, so any cut in a 1.2233-wide window reproduces the found set and 7 of 15 data-free cuts file the call and all seven printed bins at a maximum difference of 0.0000 points. Three of those are the plainest outlier reflexes there are. corr(-log10 p, the change) is +0.9576 Pearson and +0.9837 Spearman, confirmed from the shipped bundle as well as the clean truth. The three dials that move the gap each trade Gate F against Gate C one for one, 0 of 16 cells passing both, and the restricted family that holds the filed false-discovery rate spreads exactly zero on six of the seven graded figures with 12 of 13 constructions filing the golden.
